title: Opening and birth in New Orleans
summary: Interviewer opens the recording in London, 9 February 1967; Nicholas gives his birthplace and date.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Albert Nicol is talking. London, February 9, 1967. Just for the record, Albert, would you like to tell us your time and place of verse?
I was born in New Orleans, May the 27th, 1900.
Can you tell us something about your training and taking lessons and so on?
